title: ¿Cómo estás?, ¿dónde estás?, estar with other verbs, debe = must (probably)

cards.title: ¿Cómo estás? = How are you?
cards.body: Asking how someone is asks about their state, so it uses estar.

examples.en: I don't know where we are.
I'm going to be here later.
examples.es: Voy a estar aquí más tarde.

examples.en: Where are you going to be?
I am · he is · she is · you (formal) are · they are · we are · you are
examples.es: yo estoy · él está · ella está · usted está · ellos/ellas están · nosotros/nosotras estamos · tú estás

cards.title: tienen que estar
cards.body: Build tienen from tener, then add que for 'have to'.

examples.en: Where do you (all) have to be later?

cards.title: debe = must (probability)
cards.body: As in English, 'must' can mean 'probably'. Deber doesn't split.

cards.title: porque = because
cards.body: Build block by block. Rushing makes you trip, and tripping costs more time.

examples.en: We're not going to stay because we're very tired.
examples.es: No vamos a quedarnos porque estamos muy cansados.
